The Volcano Job API provides Kubernetes CRD endpoints for defining and managing batch workloads using Volcano's Job resource (vcjob). Volcano Jobs support multiple task types, lifecycle policies, gang scheduling, and integration with frameworks including TensorFlow, PyTorch, Spark, and MPI. All operations go through the Kubernetes API server.
